channel.title: Small Space Greens
channel.description: How-to guides for small-space gardening and microgreens.

item.title: How to grow microgreens in a small apartment
item.description: Set up a tray of microgreens on a shelf or counter. Steps, light, water, and harvest timing are drawn from university extension guides, not a diary.
item.author: ryan@smallspacegreens.com (Ryan Moalemi)

item.title: Microgreens kit vs DIY: what the costs are made of
item.description: Compare a microgreens kit with a do-it-yourself tray setup using labeled example price ranges and seed-cost snapshots from extension publications.
item.author: ryan@smallspacegreens.com (Ryan Moalemi)

item.title: Microgreens seed density per tray
item.description: See published grams of microgreen seed per 10 by 20 inch tray, why those figures differ, and how to scale a rate to a smaller container. Start there.
item.author: ryan@smallspacegreens.com (Ryan Moalemi)

item.title: Pea shoots vs radish microgreens
item.description: Compare pea shoots and radish microgreens with extension figures for seed weight, soaking, days to harvest, and the flavor notes those guides give.
item.author: ryan@smallspacegreens.com (Ryan Moalemi)

item.title: Can you grow microgreens on a windowsill?
item.description: Learn when a window is enough for microgreens, which crops tolerate weaker light, and when extension guides say it is time to add a lamp. Try it.
item.author: ryan@smallspacegreens.com (Ryan Moalemi)

item.title: How to start vegetable seeds in an apartment
item.description: Start vegetable transplants in an apartment with containers, sterile mix, lights, a frost-date timeline, and a calm hardening-off routine. Begin inside.
item.author: ryan@smallspacegreens.com (Ryan Moalemi)

item.title: Bottom watering for trays and microgreens
item.description: See how bottom watering works for seedlings and microgreens, why extension guides prefer it, and how long to leave a tray sitting in water. Drain after.
item.author: ryan@smallspacegreens.com (Ryan Moalemi)

item.title: A balcony salad garden in containers
item.description: Plan a balcony salad garden with container depths, hours of sun, a soilless mix, and salad crops sized for a small outdoor space. Match sun to crop.
item.author: ryan@smallspacegreens.com (Ryan Moalemi)
